items.decision_note: The visible evidence does not safely establish whether the early aircraft portfolio and the later CAS Jets portfolio are the same deliverable; this also affects whether message 44 is a scope modification or the first evidence of a separate portfolio.

items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

unresolved_candidate.description: The evidence strongly suggests that the early aircraft portfolio became the CAS Jets portfolio, but the messages do not explicitly equate the two names.
A second portfolio is clearly requested, but its business identity, subject matter, and visual requirements are not specified.
A possible custom-from-scratch design constraint is reported only through the freelancer's response to an off-platform complaint and lacks direct client evidence.
The allowed extent and cost of revisions remain disputed; the visible history contains no clear client-confirmed revision entitlement.
Potential future graphic modifications are tentative and do not yet establish a concrete independent deliverable.
